description: This PHP file defines the UsersViewEdit class, which extends ViewEdit, and manages the display and logic for editing user profiles within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM system. It includes methods for pre-display processing, retrieving metadata, rendering the form, handling request parameters, and integrating email UI components.

classes.name: UsersViewEdit
classes.description: A view class responsible for managing the user edit screen in SuiteCRM, including form display, handling user types, permissions, and integrating email functionality.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs setup tasks before rendering the display, such as initializing the UserViewHelper.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Determines the metadata file to use based on user type, affecting the form layout.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the user edit form, assigns variables for the template, manages request parameters, and outputs the email compose frame.

methods.name: getHelpText
methods.description: Provides help text with a create link if the current user has admin privileges for the Users module.
